mapper.insert: INSERT INTO procurement_operation_log (business_type, data_id, data_name, operator_id, operator_name, operation_type, operation_desc, operation_details, ip_address, create_time) VALUES (#{businessType}, #{dataId}, CASE WHEN #{businessType} = 1 AND #{dataId} > 0 THEN COALESCE((SELECT NULLIF(purchase_order_no, '') FROM contract WHERE id = #{dataId}), #{dataName}) ELSE #{dataName} END, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, #{operationType}, #{operationDesc}, #{operationDetails}, #{ipAddress}, NOW(0))
mapper.sql: CASE WHEN l.business_type = 1 THEN COALESCE( NULLIF(CONVERT(c.purchase_order_no USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci, ''), CONVERT(l.data_name USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci) ELSE CONVERT(l.data_name USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci END
CASE WHEN l.business_type = 1 AND l.operation_type = 'MODIFY' THEN 'UPDATE' ELSE l.operation_type END
l.id, l.business_type, l.data_id, AS data_name, l.operator_id, l.operator_name, AS operation_type, l.operation_desc, l.operation_details, l.ip_address, l.create_time
